What to plant in Kwara State

Quick answer: Kwara State is in Nigeria's North-Central (Southern Guinea savanna). The rainy season runs April – October. Its best-known crops are rice, soybean, white yam, sweet potato, tiger nut and egusi melon. Plant rain-fed crops only after the rains have truly started.

RegionNorth-Central
Rainy seasonApril – October
VegetationSouthern Guinea savanna
Capital (weather point)Ilorin

🌧️ Live check: have the rains started in Kwara?

  • 🫛 Soybeanplant June to July
  • 🍠 White yamplant February to April
  • 🍠 Sweet potatoplant April to July
  • 🌰 Tiger nutplant May to July
  • 🍈 Egusi melonplant April to June
  • 🌿 Jute mallow (Ewedu)plant April to July
  • 🌿 Moringaplant April to July
  • 🍍 Pineappleplant March to May
  • 🌰 Cashewplant June to July
  • 🍫 Cocoaplant April to June
  • 🎋 Sugarcaneplant March to May and November to December
  • 🌰 Kola nutplant June to July
  • 🌳 Shea treeplant June to July
  • 🌳 Locust bean (Iru)plant June to July
  • ☕ Coffee (Robusta)plant June to July
  • 🌿 Kenafplant June to July
  • 🟤 Velvet tamarind (Awin)plant June to July

Questions farmers in Kwara ask

What crops grow best in Kwara State?

Rice, Soybean, White yam, Sweet potato, Tiger nut, Egusi melon, Jute mallow (Ewedu), Moringa, Pineapple, Cashew, Cocoa, Sugarcane, Kola nut, Shea tree, Locust bean (Iru), Coffee (Robusta), Kenaf and Velvet tamarind (Awin) are among the best-known crops of Kwara State.

When does the rainy season start in Kwara State?

The rainy season in Kwara State usually runs April – October. The rains have truly started when about 20 mm of rain falls within 3 days. Use our live check before you plant.

What can I plant in Kwara State in the dry season?

With irrigation or on fadama (wet valley) land: rice, white yam, irish potato, tomato, sweet pepper (tatashe), onion, garlic and cucumber.

What should I plant in Kwara State at the start of the rains?

maize, african yam bean, cassava, white yam, water yam, cocoyam (taro), sweet potato and irish potato are commonly planted when the rains begin.
